title: Mirai_Botnet_Investigation_5cb
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a potential Mirai botnet infection within your organization's network. The Mirai botnet targets IoT devices and Linux systems, using them to perform DDoS attacks. Your goal is to identify and mitigate the botnet activity.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a potential Mirai botnet infection within your organization's network. The Mirai botnet targets IoT devices and Linux systems, using them to perform DDoS attacks. Your goal is to identify and mitigate the botnet activity.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via the provided cloud environment. Use the following credentials to log in via SSH: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox via SSH using the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: While monitoring network traffic, you noticed unusual outbound connections from `bot1`. Investigate the system to identify any unauthorized or suspicious services that might be responsible for this behavior. This is the answer to be submitted.
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, you need to check the systemd services and timers. The service responsible for periodic external communication is `bot-beacon.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and timers to identify any suspicious activities.

levels.title: Identify Traffic Generation Service
levels.content: Further investigation revealed that `bot1` is generating an abnormal volume of network traffic. Identify the service responsible for this activity. This is the answer to be submitted.
levels.solution: To identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic, you need to look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and have unusual names. The service responsible for this activity is `bot-flood.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration and have unusual names.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: You have identified the suspicious services but need to understand how they persist after a system reboot. Investigate the persistence mechanism used by these services. This is the answer to be submitted.
levels.solution: To determine the persistence mechanism, you need to examine the systemd timers and services. The persistence mechanism used by these services is `system-update-checker.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and services to find the persistence mechanism.
